description: A Flutter widget defining an accessible hint banner, providing keyboard controls information for users with accessibility needs. It is a non-intrusive banner intended to be displayed above the game board.

classes.name: A11yHintBanner
classes.description: A StatelessWidget that displays a non-modal accessibility hint banner, which can be conditionally visible and provides info about keyboard controls.

methods.name: A11yHintBanner
methods.description: Constructor for the A11yHintBanner widget, with an optional visible parameter defaulting to true.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Build method which returns the widget tree for the banner, showing a SizedBox.shrink() if not visible, or a Semantics widget containing styled text if visible.
